name: CIW International Champion
epitaph: Billed as the promotion's own top title, representing Canada and every country the promotion planned to tour; no champion is recorded in the surviving document.

name: CIW North American Champion
epitaph: Billed as the promotion's own second-ranked title, representing Mexico, the United States and Canada together; no champion is recorded in the surviving document.

name: CIW International Tag Team Champions
epitaph: Billed as the promotion's own tag titles; no champions are recorded in the surviving document.
